risks.summary: P0-A is not merged or committed
risks.impact: Consent, session, account isolation and cache protections are absent from the implementation base.
risks.mitigation: Finish P0-A on its own branch, review, commit, merge, then re-run the full prerequisite gate from fresh origin/master.

risks.summary: Private API and client cache can cross account boundaries
risks.impact: A shared device can retain Account A data for Account B, especially under offline/network failure.
risks.mitigation: Make authenticated API network-only/no-store, purge service-worker and query/user stores on auth change, and pass A→logout→B browser tests.

risks.summary: No household tenant or membership authorization boundary exists
risks.impact: Shared data cannot be safely isolated, removed members cannot be denied, and IDOR protection cannot be proven.
risks.mitigation: Implement H1 membership/capability guards first after the prerequisite gate; every query must be household-scoped.

risks.summary: Consent and safety-critical profile fixes remain unmerged
risks.impact: Optional analytics/personalization and allergy/profile state can diverge from user intent.
risks.mitigation: Keep household analytics and sensitive sharing disabled; merge and verify P0-A default-off/fail-closed behavior.

risks.impact: Concurrent changes can create duplicate meal slots and inconsistent shopping output.
risks.mitigation: Duplicate preflight then expand-compatible composite uniqueness and conflict-safe upsert; rehearse only on disposable DB.

risks.summary: Shopping and pantry semantic dedupe is race-unsafe
risks.impact: Concurrent adds can duplicate items or lose quantities.
risks.mitigation: Define normalized identity/version/idempotency policy and enforce it transactionally in PostgreSQL.

risks.impact: UI toggles can falsely imply muting while cron/delivery behavior differs.
risks.mitigation: Persist preferences/quiet hours server-side and enforce them at event and delivery time before enabling household notifications.

risks.impact: The branch cannot claim a green baseline or final PASS.
risks.mitigation: Repair or formally rebaseline the four Food DNA/onboarding smoke expectations in a separate scoped change, then rerun full tests.

risks.summary: No realtime/offline collaboration transport or protocol exists
risks.impact: Optimistic multi-user UI would lose, duplicate or replay commands without authorization/order guarantees.
risks.mitigation: Build versioned/idempotent server commands first, then the ADR-selected transport and bounded offline outbox.

risks.summary: Child and health-adjacent privacy boundaries need legal/product sign-off
risks.impact: Household membership could expose allergies, nutrition history or managed-profile data beyond intended viewers.
risks.mitigation: Parent-managed profiles only, default-off field scopes, minimum disclosure, audit/revocation, and Human Decision Gate before release.

risks.summary: Alternative photos lack a private attachment lifecycle
risks.impact: Reusing public avatar storage could expose images and metadata.
risks.mitigation: Defer photos until authenticated object delivery, type/magic checks, EXIF stripping, retention and deletion are designed.

risks.summary: Receipt OCR and social/video import carry privacy, cost and rights risk
risks.impact: Receipts contain personal data; scraping/import can violate platform terms or copyright and create support cost.
risks.mitigation: Validate demand, require review/private draft, retention deletion controls, attribution and legal/provider review before dependency selection.

risks.summary: Baseline performance is unmeasured and bundles are large
risks.impact: Household/realtime features can worsen mobile load and memory before a budget exists.
risks.mitigation: Record mobile performance and API/realtime baselines before setting thresholds; do not raise warning limits to hide regressions.

risks.summary: Disposable database separation is not yet proven
risks.impact: Migration/integration testing could target persistent or wrong data if operators infer environment from filenames.
risks.mitigation: Add an explicit disposable DB preflight and redacted target print before any household migration rehearsal.

risks.summary: JWT in localStorage has a high XSS blast radius
risks.impact: A successful script injection can exfiltrate the bearer and access household/member data until expiry or invalidation.
risks.mitigation: Human architecture gate: evaluate hardened same-site HttpOnly cookie plus CSRF/Origin controls versus a short-lived memory token/refresh design; meanwhile enforce CSP, dependency hygiene, output encoding and sessionEpoch invalidation.

risks.summary: Deployed proxy CDN object-storage push and replica topology is unknown
risks.impact: SSE buffering/timeouts, cache headers, token leakage, object ACLs, notification providers and read-after-write behavior cannot be production-approved from repository code alone.
risks.mitigation: Document and test the real deployed topology in a non-production staging environment before transport, attachment, push or replica-dependent rollout.

risks.summary: Retention and lawful-basis policy is not approved
risks.impact: Activity, invite/share metadata, household history, managed-profile data and notification intents could be retained or processed without a defensible purpose/period.
risks.mitigation: Human legal/privacy gate: approve purpose, lawful basis, retention, deletion/export and backup behavior per scope before migration or public release; proposed durations remain architecture assumptions.
